🤖 Auto Reply - AI Chatbot

Never miss a message again! "Auto Reply - AI Chatbot" is your personal AI auto-reply assistant, supporting all major messaging apps and the latest AI providers to keep your conversations flowing — even when you’re busy.

Experience the future of messaging with Auto Reply - AI Chatbot!

✨ Key Features
• 🧠 AI-Powered Replies – Smart, context-aware responses
• 📝 Custom Templates – Create personalized reply messages for quick automation
• ⏰ Smart Scheduling – Enable auto-replies during meetings, sleep, or travel
• 👥 Selective Automation – Choose specific contacts, groups, or apps for replies
• 📊 Advanced Analytics – Track reply statistics across all messaging platforms
• 🔒 Privacy First – No message data stored or shared; all processing is secure

📱 Supported Messaging Apps
• WhatsApp & WhatsApp Business
• Messenger
• SMS
• Telegram
• Instagram
• LinkedIn
• Signal
• Viber
• Slack
• Discord
• Snapchat
• LINE
• KakaoTalk
• Zalo

🎯 Perfect For
• Professionals who need to stay connected during work hours
• Business owners managing customer support
• Travelers and night owls who want smart, hands-free replies
• Anyone who wants smarter conversations with zero effort

💡 How It Works
1. Enable secure notification access
2. Select your Reply Type
3. Choose supported messaging apps
4. Configure personal or business mode
5. Let AI handle your responses intelligently!

🔐 Privacy & Security
• AI processing is secure and private
• No conversations are stored or shared
• Full control over which apps & contacts are automated

🚀 Upgrade your messaging with "Auto Reply - AI Chatbot" – the ultimate AI auto-reply assistant!
